name: Hiring Interview Debrief
description: Candidate interview debrief template for collecting evidence, ratings, concerns, and hiring recommendations.

sections.title: Candidate & Role
sections.instruction: Candidate name or ID, role, level, interview stage, interviewers, and date

sections.title: Interview Focus
sections.instruction: Summarize the competencies, skills, scenarios, or exercises assessed in this interview

sections.title: Evidence Collected
sections.instruction: List concrete evidence from candidate responses, work samples, examples, or exercises

sections.title: Strengths
sections.instruction: Summarize demonstrated strengths tied to job requirements and specific interview evidence

sections.title: Concerns & Gaps
sections.instruction: List concerns, missing signals, skill gaps, and areas requiring additional validation

sections.title: Recommendation
sections.instruction: State the recommendation, confidence level, rationale, and any calibration notes

sections.title: Follow-up Actions
sections.instruction: List next steps such as additional interviews, reference checks, compensation review, or candidate communication
